story_text:
## Your Devices Are Wireless. Your Screen Should Be Too.
## Meet Photora — the wireless touchscreen display that brings your screen anywhere you go.
We’ve grown used to the freedom of multiple screens at our desks. But when we move to coffee shops, hotel rooms, or anywhere on the go, that flexibility often disappears.
That’s why we created Photora—a wireless touchscreen display that removes the limits of traditional screens. With instant wireless casting, smooth touch interaction, and a portable 15.6" IPS display, Photora works with the devices you already use, allowing your content to move freely while giving you a bigger, more flexible way to work, create, and enjoy.
No fixed desk. No complicated setup. No need to rebuild your workspace every time your location changes. Photora is designed to move naturally between work, creativity, study, communication, and entertainment — giving you the freedom to make almost any suitable space your next workspace or personal screen.
## The Best Portable Wireless Touch Monitor
Enjoy wireless freedom and intuitive touch control in one portable display. Cast your device's screen wirelessly and interact directly with the display to navigate content, browse, and manage tasks with ease. Whether at your desk or on the go, enjoy a more flexible way to work without being tied down by cables.
Touchscreen reverse control requires touch, mouse, keyboard, and pen input to be enabled in the connected device's settings.
## Mirror & Extend Modes
Switch effortlessly between Mirror Mode and Extend Mode to fit your needs. Whether you're sharing content or creating more room for multitasking, enjoy greater flexibility for work and entertainment.
Mirror Mode displays the same content from your connected device on Photora's larger screen in real time, making it ideal for presentations, watching videos, browsing photos, and sharing content with others.
With Extend Mode, Photora becomes an independent second display, giving you more room to work. Keep your main tasks on your computer while viewing documents, referencing information, or managing other applications on the additional display.
## Turn It into Your Second Touchscreen Display
From professionals and students to creators and everyday users, Photora fits naturally into different lifestyles and workflows. Whether you're working, studying, creating, or enjoying entertainment, it gives you a more flexible way to stay productive and make the most of your screen.
## Effortless Wireless Casting
Connect easily with no app to install and no complicated setup. Enjoy a simple, seamless way to bring your content to a bigger screen.
## Gravity-Sensing Auto-Rotation
A built-in gravity sensor automatically detects the screen's orientation, making it easy to switch between portrait and landscape views. Whether you're reading documents, browsing vertical content, or working with wide-screen layouts, the display adjusts to match how you use it. No manual settings needed.
## Zoom In. Zoom Out. Your Way.
Simply use your fingers to zoom in and out with intuitive touch gestures. Enlarge details, get a closer look at content, or zoom back out whenever you need. Enjoy flexible viewing control across videos, documents, ebooks, and more.
For iPhone users, to enable reverse touch control, go to Settings → Accessibility → Zoom and turn on Zoom. Users of other compatible devices can simply connect and start using touch control.
## Your Desk Is Stationary.Your Work Isn't.
Whether you’re working from a café, staying in a hotel, creating content, or enjoying entertainment at home, Photora gives you a flexible second screen designed for every environment.
## Two Resolution Options
To give our backers more choices and a better viewing experience, we've made Photora available in two versions: FHD (1920 × 1080) for clear, crisp visuals and 4K UHD (3840 × 2160) for sharper details and greater image clarity.
## Wide Device Compatibility
Photora supports both wireless and wired connections, making it easy to connect a wide range of devices. No app required for wireless casting — simply connect your compatible iPhone (iPhone 4 or later), Android device (most devices running Android 10 or later), MacBook, Mac mini, or Windows computer. For wired connections, devices with USB-C video output or HDMI output are supported, including computers, Nintendo Switch (via dock), compatible smartphones and tablets, cameras, TV boxes, set-top boxes, and game consoles such as Xbox and PlayStation.
Wireless when you want it. Wired when you need it.
## Lightweight Strength: Aluminum Alloy Design
We believe portability shouldn't come at the expense of durability. Featuring a 15.6-inch display, Photora combines a slim 17mm profile with a lightweight 777g body, making it easy to carry wherever you go.
Crafted with an aluminum alloy body, it combines a sleek, premium appearance with dependable durability. Its slim and lightweight design brings greater flexibility to mobile work, making it easy to work beyond the traditional desk setup.
## Low-Power. More Freedom.
Whether you're working at a café, relaxing outdoors, or setting up a mobile workspace, Photora offers greater flexibility without being tied to a wall outlet. Designed for efficient power consumption, it requires just 5V/2A power input and can be powered by a compatible power bank, laptop, or USB power adapter.
Pair it with our magnetic power bank and Metal Ring for added convenience. The power bank attaches securely to the back of the monitor, creating a more compact and organized setup while giving you extra screen space wherever you go — for both work and entertainment.
## More Ways to Play with Photora
Bring more fun to your everyday moments with Photora. Enjoy a bigger, more immersive viewing experience and make entertainment more flexible, wherever you are.
## Designed For A Better Everyday Experience
From intuitive controls and built-in speakers to a flexible stand and versatile mounting options, every detail is designed to make Photora easier and more enjoyable to use.
Whether on your desk or working on the go, Photora adapts to your needs. Its adjustable rear stand offers flexible viewing angles, allowing you to switch freely between landscape and portrait modes. With standard 75 × 75mm VESA mounting holes, it can also be attached to a compatible monitor arm for a more personalized workspace.

Shipping costs will be collected after the campaign via our post-campaign survey. We estimate shipping fees to be approximately US$18-30 depending on your location. The final shipping cost will vary based on destination, package size, and weight. Our goal is to provide reliable delivery while keeping shipping costs as low as possible.
Regarding taxes, mainly in European countries, VAT is required. If applicable, we will charge VAT at the same time as shipping.
## Moving Forward to Mass Production.
Photora is moving closer to bringing wireless touch freedom to your workspace. As production progresses, each monitor goes through assembly, functional testing, and quality inspections to ensure it meets our product standards.
From display performance and wireless connectivity to touchscreen responsiveness and overall build quality, we pay attention to every detail before each unit is ready for delivery. We'll continue sharing production updates and behind-the-scenes progress as we move toward shipment.

faq.a: Kickstarter is a launchpad for creators to raise funds for the initial production of their invention. Backers (that's you!) can support the creator by pre-ordering the product at a discounted price.
In order to pledge, click that green button that says “Back this project”. You'll get to select your shipping country and choose your desired pledge level and reward.

faq.q: Does Photora require an app for wireless connection?
faq.a: No. Photora supports wireless screen casting without requiring any additional app downloads or installations.

faq.q: Can I use touch control with Photora?
faq.a: Yes. Photora features touchscreen functionality, allowing you to interact directly with the display. Touch functionality may vary depending on the connected device and operating system.

faq.q: Can I use Photora as a second monitor?
faq.a: Yes. Photora supports both Mirror Mode and Extend Mode. You can mirror your main screen or extend your computer's desktop to create additional workspace.
Yes. In addition to wireless connectivity, Photora also supports wired connections via USB-C and HDMI, giving you more flexibility when connecting your devices.
